docs.summary: Handles files dragged from the OS onto the editor window: copies them into the Project panel's current folder, where the asset watcher picks them up and imports them.
True briefly after a drop, so the import pump runs even when ReimportOnFocusOnly gates it - a drop does not necessarily focus the window.
True while a dropped batch waits for Paper's hover pass to identify the folder under the drop point - opens the ProjectPanel hover gates without an internal drag.
Enqueues file paths from an external drop for deferred processing.
Processes one batch of dropped files per frame, resolving the hover target folder and copying files into the project.
